description: This donut chart, titled “Win rate (%)”, visually represents the comparative win rates of three large language models—GPT-4o, Mistral, and LLaMA—using three distinct colored segments. The chart contains three slices, each labeled with its corresponding model name and percentage value. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents GPT-4o with a win rate of 98.4%. The second largest segment, colored blue, represents Mistral with a win rate of 1.2%. The smallest segment, colored light blue, represents LLaMA with a win rate of 3.2%. The chart includes a legend-like labeling system where each model’s name and percentage are connected by a line to its respective slice. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, with GPT-4o occupying the majority of the chart, followed by LLaMA, and then Mistral. There are no percentage labels directly inside the slices, and no segments are visually emphasized through explosion or bolding.
